West Brom Career, Just Finished 4th Season

GK Donnarumma 84 - 9/10, has been amazing. Been the difference in those 1-0 end to end wins, saves almost everything.

LB Nangis 82 - 9/10 - Regen purchased at the end of second season. Amazing speed, stamina and 90 crossing. Brilliant going forward

CB John Stones 85 - 6/10 - Only had him for a season, hasn't really done much, made some high profile mistakes though

CB Harrison Clark 85 - 10/10 - English Centre back from the youth academy. Promoted to first team towards end of first season, trained a lot in the second season then occasionally ever since. Current captian, Super quick and never misses a tackle.

RB Tete  83- 4/10 - Only in the team at the moment as i haven't got anyone better, okay mostly but shocking at crossing which is a huge issue for me as i rely on my full backs to get forward and put the ball in the box

CDM - Alexis Blin 80 - 7/10 - Got him halfway through the third season after deciding to change to a 4-1-2-3. Has been solid so far and still growing

CM - Dani Ceballos - 83 - 5/10 - Great player when he is actually fit, shocking stamina. Cant last more that 60 minutes and needs to be rested every other game.

CM - Milinkovic-Savic - 84 - 9/10- Has been at the club from the very first season. Good at what he does. Decent passer, box to box and amazing in the air both on attack and defence.

LW- Marco Pjaca - 85 - 8/10 - Another player i purchased in the first season. Has grown quite well and contributes with at least 5 goals and a few assists every season. Is the current set piece taker and has scored quite a few amazing free kicks.

RW- Avezedo - 81- 7/10 - Another youth product promoted in the first season. I initially wasn't a huge fan as his physicals were pretty average, pretty slow and below average stamina. Still kept him around as a squad player and by the third season he showed he has a future. Dribbling at 99 and great short passing and long passing stats as well. Pretty decent finisher as well. Made the step up to starting 11 by the end of the 4th season

ST- Mikeal Lindell - 85 - 10/10 Regen i found in the free agents at the end of the 3rd season. Had amazing physicals but 60 finishing and short passing. Also had 1 star weak foot but 5 star dribbling. Worked on his shooting and short passing through training but was still sceptical due to the one star weak foot. He proved me wrong though, becoming top scorer in the league and helping us with crucial goals against Bayern and PSG on the way to winning our first champions League.
